# Headlamp spring hook repair, F0 aluminum concept

**Status: functional. No part is released; see [SAFETY.md](../../SAFETY.md).**

Independent hollow hook concept for studying an additive repair of the lamp spring mount of a 993 headlamp. A commercial offer proves that metal printing is really used for this function, but no public dimension allows this F0 to be presented as its copy or as a fitted part.

## Material and manufacturing

| field | value |
|---|---|
| preferred process | LPBF |
| candidate processes | LPBF, CNC |
| material family | LPBF aluminum |
| grade | EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg / AlSi10Mg_FlexM291 2.01 / 30 µm, screening candidate not attributed to the commercial part |
| standard | DIN EN 1706 EN AC-43000 and ASTM F3318-18 per the EOS data sheet; supplier specification to be contracted |
| supplier requirements | traceable powder, machine, orientation and batch, witness coupon in the critical orientation of the arm, CT or radiography of the root and dimensional inspection, roughness report inside the groove, thermal, vibration and retention tests before any vehicle use |
| post-processing | removal of supports outside the cavity, controlled deburring of the spring groove, heat treatment tied to the machine and the parameter set, finishing of the bonding surface without rounding the future datums |
